sources.source_name: Cabinet approves setting up of Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority

access.techadyant_use: Institutional record only. No ITLA dataset exists publicly yet; the Atlas holds a schema placeholder (itla.json) for datasets the Cabinet text names.

sources.notes: ₹10,000 cr GoI commitment to an AIF under the SGF framework; majority allocation to manufacturing-focused SMEs; will consider SMEs in Tier II/III industrial clusters. No eligibility list published — Techadyant does not label any company as SGF-eligible.
